description: Explorer thumbnails and a 'Save as PNG' context-menu verb for XNA/MonoGame .xnb texture files
notes: Explorer was restarted during install, so thumbnails work immediately.
Requires the .NET 8 runtime: Microsoft.NETCore.App 8.x specifically. Roll-forward does
not cross major versions, so 9.x or 10.x will NOT work. Any one of these provides it:
winget install Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.8          (smallest, and all that is needed)
Those need admin. To avoid elevation, install .NET into your profile with
dotnet-install.ps1 -Runtime dotnet -Channel 8.0 and set DOTNET_ROOT to point at it.
64-bit only, by necessity -- 64-bit Explorer will never load a 32-bit shell extension.
The bundled xnb2png.exe is self-contained and needs no runtime at all.
Only .xnb files whose root object is a Texture2D get a thumbnail. Anything else falls
pre_install: # The thumbnail handler is a COM server whose runtime is started by hostfxr, which
# cannot roll forward across major versions -- only Microsoft.NETCore.App 8.x will do.
# Probe the same locations hostfxr does, so a per-user DOTNET_ROOT install counts.
# String concatenation, not Join-Path: Join-Path resolves the drive qualifier and errors
# noisily if a stale DOTNET_ROOT points at a drive that no longer exists.

$net8 = $roots | Where-Object { $_ } | ForEach-Object { "$_\shared\Microsoft.NETCore.App" } | Where-Object { Test-Path $_ } | ForEach-Object { Get-ChildItem $_ -Directory } | Where-Object { $v = $_.Name -as [version]; $v -and $v.Major -eq 8 }

if (!$net8) { error "$app requires the .NET 8 runtime (Microsoft.NETCore.App 8.x), which was not found. Install any one of: 'winget install Microsoft.DotNet.Runtime.8' (smallest), Microsoft.DotNet.DesktopRuntime.8, or Microsoft.DotNet.SDK.8 -- all three provide it. A 9.x or 10.x runtime will not work, because hostfxr does not roll forward across major versions."; break }
post_install: # Register against the stable 'current' junction, never the versioned directory, or
# the next update leaves a dangling InprocServer32 pointing at a deleted path. This
# expression yields the junction whether $dir is already 'current' or not.
pre_uninstall: # Must run BEFORE Scoop deletes the directory: Explorer holds the handler DLL open,
# so removal fails with a file lock unless it is unregistered and Explorer restarted.
